codexChange.reason: The CLI's nested bubblewrap sandbox cannot create namespaces under the current Docker profile. The proposed mode delegates filesystem/process/network enforcement to the external container.

traceeGuardChange.proposal: Allow setsid/setpgid only for a launcher owned by the durable container lifecycle; retain all other trace-escape restrictions and the default host process-group mode.

requiredOuterControls: Immutable cached Linux runner and observer images; explicit declared inputs
Read-only root and isolated consumer mount; only literal approved update files writable
No source create/delete grants in the first update-only profile
Private bounded scratch, no host checkout or credential/socket mounts
Unprivileged tracee; capabilities unavailable to the coding process
Network none for this qualification; synthetic model only; no real credentials
Independent protected audit observer with denied-attempt capture
Durable container ownership before start and full-container shutdown before evidence
Independent verifier remains isolated; no automatic approval, merge or deployment
requiredProof: Actual pinned Linux CLI completes the neutral synthetic tool roundtrip
Direct, symlink, hardlink and descendant protected writes are denied and independently recorded
Trace escape, inherited descriptors and namespace escape remain denied
Detached TERM-resistant descendants cannot survive container shutdown
Denied attempts, failed acceptance, interruption and stale evidence cannot become success
notAuthorizedByApproval: Live model or AWS credential use
Host sysctl changes or privileged Docker containers
alternative: Keep the CLI's internal sandbox and qualify a compatible local Linux execution profile; do not change host namespace/security settings implicitly.
